steps: Read existing RoundLoop to ensure a distinct concept
Authored SiegeDirector server script in ServerScriptService via create_instance + edit_script
Disabled the old RoundLoop so only the new system runs during VERIFY
Verified compile + enabled/disabled state via run_luau

recipe.text: Fresh concept: a credit-BUDGET wave director (spend-down budget drip-feeds enemies) defended by an automated combat SENTRY. The sentry acquires the nearest live enemy each fireInterval and deals real TakeDamage projectile combat — genuine damage-dealing gameplay, NOT a self-kill/TestAutoKill hook (gate-safe). Enemies spawn on a ring from ServerStorage.EnemyTemplate; each wave clears when all enemies are down (Died/removed), then VICTORY. All lifecycle events (online, prep, assault start, spawn, sentry hits, enemy down, wave cleared, victory) print with a [Siege] tag for VERIFY to observe via playtest_logs. State exposed on Workspace attributes SiegeWave/SiegeEnemiesLeft/SiegeState.
